question.text: The internal energy change when a system goes from state $\mathrm{A}$ to $\mathrm{B}$ is $40 \mathrm{~kJ} / \mathrm{mole}$. If the system goes from $\mathrm{A}$ to $\mathrm{B}$ by a reversible path and retums to state $\mathrm{A}$ by an irreversible path what would be the net change in internalenergy?

solution.text: For a cyclic process the net change in the internal energy is zero because the change in internal energy does not depend on the path.
